scheme_name: Institutional Support for Development and Marketing of Tribal Products/Produce
other_conditions: Eligibility is limited to Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation (TRIFED), State Tribal Development Cooperative Corporations, State Forest Development Corporations, Minor Forest Produce Trading and Development Federations, and other institutions identified for product design, development, export processing, training, patenting, trademark, research, GI certification, and related activities.
benefits_summary: Provides financial and infrastructural support for marketing, product development, training, research, and supply‑chain infrastructure to enhance tribal products and ensure reasonable pricing.
